**Checkout verification:** the merged graph at `/Users/sauravverma/programs/benchmarks/react-ecosystem/cross-repo/_indexes/graphify/merged` is live (240,420 nodes / 447,505 edges) and resolves nodes from all the pinned repos I answer from (`db`, `redux-devtools`, `tldraw`, `react`, `query`, `zustand`, `router`). Every path below came from `query_graph` / `get_node` / `get_neighbors` against that graph.

**Symptom:** `packages/db/src/redux-devtools-extension-panel-sync.ts` — its `onMessage()` calls `applyEnvelope()` directly (graph edge at L96), with `PanelBackgroundConnection` / `PanelPersistenceCoordinator` as the transport: a foreign panel message applied as a local call.

**Contract owners found elsewhere in the roster:** `extension/src/pageScript/suiteSync.ts` (redux-devtools) gates every inbound event through `isSyncEnvelope()` + `isSyncMessageAllowed()` before `broadcast()` touches contents; `packages/redux-devtools-remote/src/devTools.ts` routes failures through `.sendError()` rather than letting them vanish; `packages/sync-core/src/lib/chunk.ts` (tldraw) splits oversized payloads and reassembles via `JsonChunkAssembler`; and the react/query stream-producer paths turn producing-side failures into values the consumer can observe.
